## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the users migration before merge so rollback can recover legacy email values written after migration 2.

## Changes

The pull request drops `users.legacy_email` and `orders.coupon_code`. It adds a test that checks both column removals and verifies that the orders backup retains the coupon code.

## Critical

- migrations/m0003_drop_legacy_email.py:7 — correctness — Back up users before dropping legacy_email — A user whose `legacy_email` was set after migration 2 loses that value when migration 3 drops the column. `migrations/safety.py:4` documents the backup step that migration 3 skips. — A rollback that restores the column cannot recover those values from the migration backups. — Fix: Call `backup_table(conn, "users", VERSION)` before the drop and extend `test_drop_retired_columns`.
